import numpy as np
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

MODEL = "BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5"
REV = "7999e1d3359715c523056ef9478215996d62a620"
QUERY = "terminal-bench"

with open("/app/data.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    lines = [ln.rstrip("\n") for ln in f]
while lines and lines[-1] == "":
    lines.pop()
print(f"num docs: {len(lines)}")

model = SentenceTransformer(MODEL, revision=REV)
print("model loaded")

q_emb = model.encode([QUERY], normalize_embeddings=True, show_progress_bar=False)
d_emb = model.encode(lines, normalize_embeddings=True, show_progress_bar=False)

cos = d_emb @ q_emb[0]  # both normalized => cosine
order = np.argsort(-cos, kind="stable")  # descending similarity

print("\nRanking (descending):")
for rank, idx in enumerate(order, start=1):
    print(f"{rank:2d}. {cos[idx]:.6f}  {lines[idx]}")

top5_idx = order[4]
print(f"\n5th highest -> line {top5_idx+1}: {lines[top5_idx]}")
with open("/app/result.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(lines[top5_idx] + "\n")
print("written to /app/result.txt")
EOF
